subject.title: fix: preserve tool-result text across media fallback and context pressure

question: Should non-trailing fresh tool results be protected by this PR’s runtime-context-specific transparency rule, or by the broader projection-freshness invariant in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524?
rationale: Both approaches cover the demonstrated runtime-context case but define different long-term aggregate-recovery ownership rules, which requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use projection freshness
options.body: Adopt the broader projection-state invariant, carry this PR’s `convertToLlm` runtime-context regression into it, and remove the public helper behavior change.

options.title: Use carrier transparency
options.body: Keep this narrower runtime-context exception, preserve the public helper contract, and close the overlapping broader candidate after confirming other non-substantive tail messages need no protection.

recommendation.title: Use projection freshness
recommendation.body: Adopt the broader projection-state invariant, carry this PR’s `convertToLlm` runtime-context regression into it, and remove the public helper behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent current-main work owns the aggregate projection and trailing-result policy affected by this choice.
